title: Implement project initialization and derived mutable roots
goal: Preview and apply a stable external project context with safe OS-derived StateRoot and EvidenceRoot defaults while leaving TargetRoot untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: Init requires an explicit TargetRoot and derives stable OS-specific external roots.
Relocation and independent overrides receive canonical path ownership overlap permission and link checks.
Preview/apply uses an exact stale-resistant hash and writes only external receipted context data.
Low-level Host operations still receive four explicit roots and Init never writes TargetRoot.
risks: Derived paths could overlap Target or package authority.
OS identity differences could destabilize project context.
decisions: Use one project container with sibling state and evidence roots.
